slides.title: Why we ditched cron jobs for n8n
slides.subtitle: 5 lessons from migrating 40+ scheduled tasks

slides.title: The problem
slides.body: Cron jobs were silent killers. When one failed at 3am, we found out at 9am from an angry user.

slides.title: Lesson 1: Visibility wins
slides.body: Every workflow needs a place where humans can see green or red. Logs in /var/log don't count.

slides.title: Lesson 2: Retries are cheap
slides.body: Building retry logic in bash takes hours. In n8n it's a checkbox.

slides.title: Your turn
slides.body: What's the worst cron incident you've lived through?
